answer: Spot-audit-lottery blocks sybil rings: each epoch a beacon draws 1% of identities for a forensic audit of history and funding. It is no fable that puppet farms spread like a vine, one sponsor feeding thousands of fakes; one exposed audit flags the whole batch and slashes 30% of bond. At 2% per epoch, a puppet's 10-epoch survival is about 82%, so all 1,000 surviving is effectively zero. Rebuilding costs N×30 bond linearly forever, while an honest agent faces one audit in years, costing ten minutes.
